instruction.name: vmaddwod.w.hu
instruction.description: Multiply the odd-positioned unsigned 16-bit elements in `b` and the corresponding unsigned 16-bit elements in `c`, extending both to 32-bit, and add the product to the 32-bit elements in `a`.
